name: dmcheck
description: Deterministic conduct verdicts for live tabletop sessions. Input: a session transcript (JSONL {ts,author,content} or Discord-API JSON array), an optional engine ledger, and a versioned table charter. Output: findings that cite the violated charter rule with evidence. False accusations are the unforgivable bug: ambiguity produces silence.

commands.dmcheck run <transcript> --gm <name> [--: referee the session; findings as JSON

boundaries: Table PROCEDURE only: no rules adjudication (srdcheck), no character math (charactercheck), no narrative-quality judging (taste is not checkable), no model calls anywhere.
